purpose: Three-body additivity with a C-C pair: B, C, C at the vertices of an equilateral triangle of side 5, at rest. C-C (P-0005 c4, K = 12.36) is the species pair whose factorisation failed (H9), so this run puts it into an N = 3 configuration. Pre-registered: pairwise sum of P-0005 coefficients (B on C -6.10, C on B -10.59, C on C 12.36), T = 2. Rule: residual rms <= 0.07 per coordinate supports the table in an N = 3 setting; > 0.12 refutes pairwise additivity or the C-C value.
